[B][COLOR accent_color]Version $INFO[System.AddonVersion(skin.fentastic)][/COLOR][/B] - Fix missing movie and TV show search results by restoring proven search reload path - Restore search-history XML regeneration and active provider checks - Preserve widget row-only refresh, ratings, cache and other optimizations - Update searches and search history without full skin reloads - Skip disabled/uninstalled search providers, including provider selection - Prevent text labels from being passed as clearlogo image filenames - Add a valid FENtastic Helper icon and fanart assets
[B][COLOR accent_color]Version 1.0.45[/COLOR][/B] - Prevent empty searches from launching POV and other search providers - Reduce cached widget SQLite initialization and read connections - Join background Helper threads on Kodi shutdown where possible - Render focused fanart URLs as images, not multiimage directories
[B][COLOR accent_color]Version 1.0.44[/COLOR][/B] - Refresh only changed widget rows via dynamic content revision; no routine full ReloadSkin - Preserve coordinated full reload for widget/menu layout edits - Populate cached video metadata through InfoTagVideo (Kodi 22) instead of deprecated setInfo - Ship an empty SearchHistory XML include with the skin to avoid startup warnings - Serialize MDbList ratings requests, skip stale titles, add HTTP timeouts and retry cooldown - Reuse MDbList HTTPS connection and update ratings only for the selected title - Avoid repeated rating-property clearing and redundant XML/reloads on search open - Skip unchanged menu/widget XML writes; preserve widget-cache behavior
[B][COLOR accent_color]Version 1.0.42[/COLOR][/B] - Keep successful POV widget responses up to 30s after a 5s soft timeout - Continue fetching later rows; commit late results safely to SQLite - Never overwrite newer snapshots; preserve cache and widget configuration
[B][COLOR accent_color]Version 1.0.41[/COLOR][/B] - EXPERIMENTAL: 5-second soft timeout per POV widget row; try next row if slow - Kodi cannot cancel a call; cap overlapping requests at two and defer further calls - Preserve old SQLite widget results and 1-second skin-reload timing
[B][COLOR accent_color]Version 1.0.40[/COLOR][/B] - Restore ordinary Reload skin power-menu action (no widget cache clearing) - Remove temporary cold-build benchmark instrumentation and keep cache behavior
[B][COLOR accent_color]Version 1.0.39[/COLOR][/B] - Reduce coordinated skin-reload cooldown from 4 to 1 second - Reduce both configuration and cache-change debounces from 3 to 1 second - Still avoid reloads during POV directory fetches and widget edit dialogs - Preserve SQLite widget cache, ratings, metadata and refresh intervals
[B][COLOR accent_color]Version 1.0.37[/COLOR][/B] - Shorten coordinated skin-reload cooldown from 8 to 4 seconds - Keep 3-second debounce and avoid reloads during POV directory fetches - Preserve SQLite widget cache, ratings, metadata and refresh intervals
[B][COLOR accent_color]Version 1.0.36[/COLOR][/B] - Coordinate widget/menu skin reloads in one worker; debounce rapid edits - Wait until sequential POV directory fetches finish before reloading - Preserve existing SQLite snapshots, cache TTLs, ratings and metadata
[B][COLOR accent_color]Version 1.0.35[/COLOR][/B] - Fix Kodi JSON-RPC widget listing fields to preserve year, runtime, genre, studio and age ratings - Restore original InfoPanel rating icons when cached items have sparse metadata - Preserve persistent widget snapshots and refresh them automatically without deleting stale results
[B][COLOR accent_color]Version 1.0.34[/COLOR][/B] - Restore original IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes and other MDbList widget-label/InfoPanel ratings for cached widgets - Read IMDb IDs from the focused widget row and retain existing ratings layout - Keep persistent SQLite widget cache and sequential background refresh
[B][COLOR accent_color]Version 1.0.33[/COLOR][/B] - Restore cached IMDb/TMDb IDs, available ratings and watched/resume metadata - Add Open original POV list context-menu option (POV actions remain native) - Keep SQLite snapshots and sequential background refresh
[B][COLOR accent_color]Version 1.0.32[/COLOR][/B] - Experimental persistent SQLite cache for all configured widgets - Sequential upstream refresh; stable Kodi plugin widget paths - Retain old cache when a widget provider is temporarily unavailable - WARNING: POV playback, context menus and Kodi 22 rendering require testing
[B][COLOR accent_color]Version 1.0.31[/COLOR][/B] - Fix sequential widget loading when switching Movies / TV Shows - Retry unopened widgets and skip stalled empty rows sooner - Respect numerical order for widgets 1 to 10
[B][COLOR accent_color]Version 1.0.30[/COLOR][/B] - Load configured home widgets sequentially (one provider at a time) - No parallel/batch-loading mode; supports stacked widgets - Match Big Poster spacing to regular Poster widgets - Keep four large posters visible; also update stacked widgets
[B][COLOR accent_color]Version 1.0.28[/COLOR][/B] - Resize regular Poster widgets to the previous Big Poster size - Enlarge Big Poster home widgets to show four posters across
[B][COLOR accent_color]Version 1.0.27[/COLOR][/B] - Fix POV people search launching an unexpected keyboard - Correct the empty-history New Search button
[B][COLOR accent_color]Version 1.0.26[/COLOR][/B] - Fix custom window/include loading for Kodi 22 - Hide failing POV keyword search rows pending a supported route - Include empty search history on first startup
[B][COLOR accent_color]Version 1.0.25[/COLOR][/B] - Quick fix for landscape artwork
[B][COLOR accent_color]Version 1.0.24[/COLOR][/B] - Updated skin for Kodi Omega - Added Search support for POV and Seren - Other small fixes
[B][COLOR accent_color]Version 1.0.23[/COLOR][/B] - Fixed a few bugs related to one-click trailers - Added search window (SW) functionality for FEN Light and Umbrella • Set the default add on to use in Skin settings » Search • Choose between FEN, FEN Light, and Umbrella • Functionality extends to TRAKT button and default search dialog • Included SW hot swap button to change search providers on the fly - Moved 'Clear Search History' to Search tab in Skin settings - Other small bug fixes
[B][COLOR accent_color]Version 1.0.22[/COLOR][/B] - Fixed ratings not showing on some items - Readded Embuary Helper/Info functionality to Video Info window
[B]Please make sure to clear the ratings cache and restart Kodi before trying to fetch ratings again.[/B]
[B][COLOR accent_color]Version 1.0.21[/COLOR][/B] - Switched ratings source to MDbList for better tvshow support (enter MDbList API Key in Skin settings to activate) - Created Ratings section in Skin settings - Added on/off toggles for individual ratings - Added high quality icons for ratings - Added optional one-click trailers (requires MDbList API Key) - Added IMDb popular ratings. These are from IMDb's most popular movies and tvshows. The rating for these is out of 100. The color coding of the new flame icon is as follows:
• [COLOR blueviolet][B]PURPLE[/B][/COLOR] flame = Top 10 • [COLOR deeppink][B]PINK[/B][/COLOR] flame = Top third (10 - 33) • [COLOR darkorange][B]ORANGE[/B][/COLOR] flame = Middle third (33 - 66) • [COLOR dodgerblue][B]BLUE[/B][/COLOR] flame = Bottom third (66 - 100)
[B]IMPORTANT: After you have entered in your MDbList API key, I HIGHLY recommend clicking the "Clear ratings cache" button in Skin settings and then restarting Kodi before trying to fetch new ratings again. If you do not do this you may run into errors. This is a one time thing that will minimize the possibility of running into issues related to the switch to MDbList.[/B]

[B]IMPORTANT NOTICE: IF YOUR WIDGETS WERE DELETED AFTER THIS UPDATE PLEASE READ INFO BELOW
In this version the default widgets that you may have seen on first install have been removed. In order to avoid possible future conflicts and/or errors, please go to Skin settings » Main menu items » click Remake Menus and Widgets. This will remove the default widgets if any and remake the ones you have already set up. If you didn't set up any widgets on first install, and all of your widgets were deleted, go back into Skin settings » Main menu items in order to set up your widgets. See Setup Guide for help setting up your widgets. This is a one-time thing and will not be necessary for future updates.[/B]

include.name: SetupGuide
include.label:
[B][COLOR accent_color]Welcome to the FENtastic Setup Guide[/COLOR][/B]
FENtastic is a skin specifically designed for FEN users. It can display movie, tvshow, and episode widgets as well as submenu widgets. It can also set paths for main menu items (more on this later). Here in this guide I will show you how these work and how to set them up.
On first install the home screen should be empty. This means that the Movie and Show sections should be missing from the main menu on the left.
Now lets go set up the widgets. From this dialog screen click Back on your remote or Backspace if you are using a keyboard. Here you'll see a group of menu items on the left. Navigate up to Main menu items. Here is where we will set up the widgets.
Click a menu item to toggle the display of a section on and off. This will show or hide the section on the home screen. Now toggle the Movie/Show section to 'on'. You'll see a couple of menu items drop down. They are set main menu path and set widgets.
[B][COLOR deeppink]- Set main menu path[/COLOR][/B] is for setting up the path when clicking on the Movie/Show section in the main menu on the left side of the home screen. You can set this to whatever you path you like within FEN. I like to set mine to my Trakt movie/tvshow collection.
[B][COLOR deeppink]- Set widgets[/COLOR][/B] is for setting up the movie/tvshow widgets. These are the main widgets that you'll set up. You can configure up to 10 movie and 10 TV show widgets. After choosing a path you'll have the option to set the label and display type (Poster, Landscape, LandscapeInfo, and Category) for each widget. If you choose the Category display type, you'll have the option to set it up as a stacked widget. After that you can choose the display type for the stacked widget as well.
[B][COLOR accent_color]Stacked widgets[/COLOR][/B] contain a category widget and a normal widget beneath. The category widget "communicates" with the normal widget in order to load the new widget list according to the focused item in the category widget. If the stacked widget that you set up has 20 items in it, then that means you'll be able to have all 20 widgets available from just one widget on the home screen.
That's it! You're all set to go. Enjoy the skin!
If you would like to see a more detailed version of this Setup Guide, please visit my Github repo at https://github.com/ivarbrandt/skin.fentastic
